_comment: Behavioural row source for campaign.py board (Task 31). playbook.json routes by TECH fingerprint; several of the highest-paying classes (race, business-logic, IDOR) follow from what an ENDPOINT DOES, not what it is built with, so a tech-only board never creates them and coverage reports them as permanent gaps. board matches these patterns against state.md's endpoint/url/param columns. `requires.write_policy` lists the envelope values under which the row may run; a stricter policy parks it. `requires.burst` marks a row that needs the rate-control exemption (Task 31b). Add classes here, no code.

signals: a balance or quota is decremented
a one-time token or code is consumed
a numeric or UUID identifier addresses an object
the object belongs to an account
